title: Chess Class — Chess
text: new Creating new instance Chess class. ascii Print board via console. clear Remove pieces board. fen Return actual Forsyth Edwards notation. pgn Return Portable Game notation. get Return piece spicific square argument. history Return vector containing moves current game.        argument verbose=TRUE added method return data frame. game_over Returns TRUE game ended via checkmate, stalemate,        draw, threefold repetition, insufficient material. Otherwise, returns FALSE. in_check Returns true false side move check. in_checkmate Returns true false side move checkmated. in_draw Returns true false game drawn 50 move rule insufficient material. in_stalemate Returns true false side move stalemated. in_threefold_repetition Returns true false current board position occurred three times. insufficient_material Returns true game drawn due insufficient material (K vs. K, K vs. KB, K vs. KN); otherwise false. move Attempts make move board, returning move object        move legal, otherwise null. .move function can called two ways,        passing string Standard Algebraic Notation SAN: moves Returns vector legals moves current position.        function takes optional parameter controls single square move generation verbosity. validate_fen Returns validation object specifying validity errors found within FEN string. load load_pgn Load moves game stored Portable Game Notation. put Place piece square piece object. remove Remove return piece square. reset Reset board initial starting position. square_color Returns color square (light dark). turn Returns current side move. undo Takeback last halfmove, returning move object successful. header Allows header information added PGN output.        number key value pairs can passed header(). get_header Get header actual game via list object. history_detail Return detailed version history(verbose=TRUE). summary Print summary object. plot Plot object chessboard.js ggplot2. print Print summary ob Chess object.
